title: File:68th IAEA General Conference, Xinhua News Agency Interview, Vienna, September 2024, 09.jpg
desc:
HE Mr. LI Song, Resident Representative of China to the IAEA listens to Rafael Mariano Grossi, IAEA Director General during an interview by Chinese Xinhua Media at the IAEA 68th General Conference held at the Agency headquarters in Vienna, Austria. 20 September 2024. 
Photo Credit: Dean Calma / IAEA
